sources.verified_angle_summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has announced the launch of its first-ever AWS AI Academy at LEAP 2026 in Riyadh, running from August 31 to September 3, 2026. The program offers a free, comprehensive "Learn, Build, Certify" framework open to all LEAP attendees. It features the AWS AI Training Academy, which provides expert-led instruction and hands-on labs focusing on generative AI and Amazon Bedrock, and the AWS Agentic AI Hackathon, where teams build real-world AI solutions. Participants who complete the extended cohort program requirements are eligible for an AWS AI Practitioner Certification voucher. This specific educational initiative provides a concrete, high-value angle compared to generic event previews, highlighting AWS's commitment to building AI skills in the region.
sources.verified_key_facts: AWS is launching the AWS AI Academy for the first time at LEAP 2026; The program is free and open to all LEAP 2026 attendees; It includes the AWS AI Training Academy with expert-led instruction and hands-on labs (Aug 31 & Sept 2); It features the AWS Agentic AI Hackathon for building real-world AI solutions (Sept 1 & Sept 3); Participants use AWS tools like Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Q; The initiative offers a pathway to an AWS AI Practitioner Certification voucher through an extended cohort program; The event is located at the LEAP Academy, Hall 5, RECC Malham, Riyadh.
